structured_output.content: The v1.18.0 change adds ACME Certificate Profiles support. The environment uses cert-manager with `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` manifests and the `certificates.cert-manager.io` CRD installed. However, the provided values keys and environment summary do not confirm whether ACME Issuer or ClusterIssuer resources are deployed or configured. Check your Issuer/ClusterIssuer manifests to determine if any use the ACME provider; if so, this feature may apply.
